explanation: Light affection such as hand-holding or a quick kiss between couples is unremarkable in Dutch public life, consistent with a generally relaxed, pragmatic culture. More prolonged or overt displays aren't illegal or shocking, but can draw a little more attention in a culture that otherwise favors reserved, understated public behavior.
local_tip: Keep public affection brief and low-key, and take your cues from how comfortable the locals around you seem.

also_check.note: Public displays of affection, even hand-holding, can be illegal and lead to fines or arrest.
Cheek kissing as a greeting and casual affection between couples are widely accepted and common in public.
Public displays of affection are uncommon and can draw attention; even hand-holding tends to be discreet.
